entities.summary: Park An-su (b. 1968-09-23, Cheongdo County) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Cheongdo County and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, military leaders & commanders, asia.
